remaining.title: Overall accuracy metric crashes on an empty corpus or fully filtered report
remaining.evidence: The code computes overall accuracy as a direct division by 'len(scores)' with no empty-case guard, unlike the other aggregate metrics that handle zero denominators.
remaining.evidence_quote: m3 = sum(1 for c in scores.values() if c["correct"]) \
remaining.recommendation: Guard the denominator before dividing, for example returning 0.0 or None when there are no cases to score, consistent with the handling used for the other metrics in this module.

remaining.title: Fallback provider already a primary seat not prevented from overriding
remaining.recommendation: The check correctly rejects fallbacks that conflict with primary seats, but ensure the fallback logic does not silently drop or reassign primary providers when multiple fallbacks are configured.

remaining.title: New CLI commands added without test coverage
remaining.recommendation: Add unit tests for the new CLI subcommands (_sarif_main, _policy_main, _evidence_main, _setup_main, _doctor_main, _record_verify_main, _disputes_main, _locate_main, _bench_main, _acceptance_main) and ensure they exercise the new argument parsing and core logic paths.

remaining.title: Archived-text classification depends on split_patch_sections output
remaining.recommendation: Confirm that split_patch_sections handles all patch shapes produced by the chain, and add a unit test verifying the _split_archived_text result does not lose or duplicate findings.

remaining.title: Evidence-sidecar verification accepts refs with empty or malformed sha256 values
remaining.recommendation: Reject refs whose sha256 is not exactly 64 lowercase hex characters before attempting to load a sidecar file, and report them as invalid evidence refs. This should mirror the strict hash-format checks used elsewhere in the file.

remaining.title: Normalized finding uses serving_name instead of name
remaining.recommendation: Verify that serving_name is the intended parameter; if name was the original intent, restore it to avoid unexpected normalization behavior.

remaining.title: build_inventory does not deduplicate findings across records
remaining.recommendation: Add dedup by finding id before appending to open_rows; track seen ids in a set and skip duplicates. Without dedup, the same open dispute can appear multiple times, inflating the inventory and causing false freshness violations.

remaining.title: records_touching_span iterates all records without timeout or limit
remaining.recommendation: Add a maximum record limit or timeout guard; consider pagination or incremental scanning for large repos. Ensure the function can fail safely rather than hanging indefinitely.
